name: stb
description: Single-file public domain libraries for C and C++, including stb_image.
summary: Code or documentation generated by LLMs or other generative AI is not accepted, and AI autocompletion should not be used either. Pull requests and issues must be written by the contributor, even in imperfect English.

evidence.quote: This project doesn't accept code or documentation generated by LLMs or any other forms of generative AI.
Please don't submit pull requests based on generative AI output, and don't use AI auto completion when you write pull requests.
Additionally, don't use LLMs to create pull requests or issues.
Write them yourself, in English, even if your English is bad.
